capabilities.label: AP automation
capabilities.detail: AI/OCR invoice capture, multi-step approval workflows, duplicate detection, and multiple payment rails (ACH/check/card/wire/international) appear in QuickBooks, Xero, Sage Intacct, Bill.com, Ramp, and Brex.
features: and multiple payment rails (ACH/check/card/wire/international) appear in QuickBooks

capabilities.label: AR/invoicing
capabilities.detail: branded customizable invoices, recurring invoices, automated payment reminders/dunning, online "pay now" links, and aging reports are near-universal (QBO, Xero, Sage Intacct, Bill.com, Stripe).
features: and aging reports are near-universal (QBO, Xero, Sage Intacct, Bill.com, Stripe).

capabilities.label: Bank reconciliation
capabilities.detail: automatic bank feeds with AI/rule-based auto-categorization and matching in every accounting-ledger vendor.
features: automatic bank feeds with AI/rule-based auto-categorization and matching in every accounting-ledger vendor.

capabilities.label: Accounting-system sync
capabilities.detail: the spend/card/billing players all treat QuickBooks / Xero / Sage Intacct / NetSuite as the system of record and offer deep two-way GL sync (Bill.com, Ramp, Brex, Stripe RevRec) — they layer on top of the ledger rather than replace it.
features: the spend/card/billing players all treat QuickBooks / Xero / Sage Intacct / NetSuite as the system of record and offer deep two-way GL sync (Bill.com, Ramp, Brex, Stripe RevRec) — they layer on top of the ledger rather than replace it.

capabilities.label: Corporate cards + spend controls
capabilities.detail: unlimited physical/virtual cards, per-card/category/merchant limits, real-time policy enforcement, freeze/lock — the shared core of Ramp, Brex, and Bill.com (Divvy).
features: freeze/lock — the shared core of Ramp

capabilities.label: Expense management
capabilities.detail: receipt OCR capture, auto-categorization, reimbursements, mileage, per diem recur across Ramp, Brex, Bill.com, Xero Expenses, QBO.

capabilities.label: Reporting/dashboards
capabilities.detail: real-time customizable dashboards, P&L/balance-sheet/cash-flow, drill-down across all ledger vendors, with real-time spend analytics on the card platforms.
features: with real-time spend analytics on the card platforms.

capabilities.label: Multi-currency/international payments
capabilities.detail: FX-priced cross-border payments + multi-currency ledgers everywhere except entry-tier accounting.
features: FX-priced cross-border payments + multi-currency ledgers everywhere except entry-tier accounting.

capabilities.label: AI/automation agents
capabilities.detail: every vendor markets an AI layer — Intuit Assist, Sage Copilot, BILL AI, Ramp Intelligence agents, Brex Assistant, Stripe Smart Retries — for coding, anomaly/fraud detection, close automation.
features: every vendor markets an AI layer — Intuit Assist

capabilities.label: Accounting ledgers vs spend layers
capabilities.detail: QuickBooks, Xero, Sage Intacct are the actual double-entry GL/system-of-record; Ramp, Brex, Bill.com are spend/AP layers that sync into those ledgers and monetize via card interchange/cashback (cards & software often free) rather than seat licenses.
features: Sage Intacct are the actual double-entry GL/system-of-record; Ramp
Bill.com are spend/AP layers that sync into those ledgers and monetize via card interchange/cashback (cards & software often free) rather than seat licenses.

capabilities.label: Mid-market ERP depth (Sage Intacct only)
capabilities.detail: multi-dimensional GL, multi-entity global consolidation, ASC 606 rev rec, project/fund/grant accounting, industry verticals — capabilities QuickBooks/Xero explicitly lack (multi-entity is a known gap).
features: industry verticals — capabilities QuickBooks/Xero explicitly lack (multi-entity is a known gap).

capabilities.label: Billing engine (Stripe only)
capabilities.detail: subscription + usage-based/metered billing, dunning/Revenue Recovery, entitlements/feature gating, developer/API-first billing — the only one with true metered/usage billing at scale.
features: developer/API-first billing — the only one with true metered/usage billing at scale.

capabilities.label: Business banking/treasury (Ramp & Brex)
capabilities.detail: FDIC-swept checking/vault, money-market yield, cash-flow forecasting — the accounting vendors do not bundle a business bank account.
features: cash-flow forecasting — the accounting vendors do not bundle a business bank account.

capabilities.label: Travel & procurement (Ramp & Brex)
capabilities.detail: in-app travel booking with policy enforcement + full purchase-request-to-PO procurement are unique to the spend-management platforms.
features: in-app travel booking with policy enforcement + full purchase-request-to-PO procurement are unique to the spend-management platforms.

capabilities.label: Payroll
capabilities.detail: native only in QuickBooks (Core/Premium/Elite); Xero relies on Gusto (US) or in-region payroll; the spend/billing vendors have none.
features: native only in QuickBooks (Core/Premium/Elite); Xero relies on Gusto (US) or in-region payroll; the spend/billing vendors have none.

capabilities.label: Vendor network (Bill.com)
capabilities.detail: BILL's millions-strong vendor payment network + W-9/1099 verification is its signature moat.
features: BILL's millions-strong vendor payment network + W-9/1099 verification is its signature moat.

capabilities.label: Rewards ceilings
capabilities.detail: Brex up to 7x category cashback and Bill.com/Divvy up to 7x, vs Ramp's flat ~1.5–5% savings-oriented model.
features: Brex up to 7x category cashback and Bill.com/Divvy up to 7x
